description: Folders the tools may use, and how, checked by gatekeepers/fs/fs_gate.py.
Each key is the name the model uses as the first part of a path
Each value is a path string (read-only), or an object: path (absolute, starting with ~,
or relative to the agents repository), access (some of r = read, w = write, x = execute:
run programs there, or make), and optional subpaths that override the access for sub-folders.
Access applies to everything inside a folder; nothing outside these folders can be reached.
pr_gated: true puts the folder's git clone under the pull request gate (gatekeepers/pr):
its origin must be on github.com, and gh must be signed in with write access to it.
